children: El Pollo Loco named Damon Thomas chief operating officer and will enter the New York market with plans to open a location in Queens in mid-2027.

The grilled chicken chain with more than 500 locations said Tuesday it has agreed to terms for three development agreements for 15 area restaurants over five years. The Costa Mesa, Calif., company has restaurants in 10 states and in the Philippines.
A 2006 securities filing mentions development agreements for New York and New Jersey from previous years that had since terminated.

In addition to hiring Thomas, who worked for Shake Shack and Raising Cane's, El Pollo Loco said Tara Hinkle joined the company in July as chief development officer. She was previously president and head of Americas for The Coffee Bean & Tea Leaf.

The company noted "improved restaurant economics and continued progress against the company's transformation plan" and said the development agreements "reflect growing consumer interest in protein-forward meals made with quality ingredients."
On Aug. 6, El Pollo Loco said quarterly comparable sales rose 3.9%.
